prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Swablu (파비코) personified, normal / flying type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut and skin tone; her figure follows BODY TYPE; expression and hair motion may change.

FACE: exactly the face of the attached image — the same face shape, jawline, eye shape and size, nose, lips and their proportions, and the same skin rendering. From any camera angle or pose — low or high camera, chin resting on a hand, profile, looking back — keep the reference image’s face shape, jaw length and face length-to-width ratio; perspective and pose must never lengthen her lower face or make her jaw look heavier than in the reference. Do not add skin texture, pores, harder nose or lip modelling, a face lengthened by the camera angle, a heavy jaw, or any facial definition the attached image does not have.

BODY TYPE: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted — it reads clearly through the outfit. The attached image's armor hides her figure, so take her body shape from this line, not from the armor's outline; her head stays in natural adult proportion to her body.

STYLE: High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. A bright, adorable adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Highly detailed clothing and accessories with convincing fabric weave, stitching, folds, seams, buckles and material-specific reflections. Combine stylized anime facial features with richly rendered dimensional clothing. Use luminous midtones and restrained highlights on clothing, keeping her own colours in soft, clean tints. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her species shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never armor, never a creature costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame. This crop wins over every other line: details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image. Both shoulders and upper arms show and run on past the edge — never an armless torso.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: the cabin of a Ferris wheel high above an amusement park, a bench seat and wide windows onto the park far below
Weather / season: spring — blossom petals drifting outside.
Time of day: midday — bright even light; a bright square of sunlight from the window on the floor.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a stylised uniform-inspired costume with crisp lapels and decorative epaulettes, no real insignia; styled with a small jewelled hair clip
Outfit colours: bright fuchsia — her own colour choice for this outfit, not her species' colours.
Cut: plunging neckline and cutout waist built into the outfit — a figure-hugging fit that follows her curves; chest and pelvis stay securely covered.
POSTURE: sitting astride a chair turned backwards, leaning her chest lightly toward its backrest.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head turned back over her shoulder; camera slightly above, looking down at her; the camera stands outside, looking in at her through a large pane of clear glass — one edge of its frame shows at a side of the image and faint reflections lie on its surface, while she is inside the lit space beyond.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
GAZE: she looks out of the window.
EXPRESSION: challenging eyes under lowered lids, one brow raised, mouth corner tugged in a slight smirk. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more shoulder, neckline and upper-back exposure inside the crop; cover the chest
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: balanced — her species shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face and hair — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; the part of that outfit inside the crop must read at first glance in its own colours. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; where the place is busy, a few background people may share the scene — same ground, light and style, sized for their distance, busy with their own activity, never facing the camera or posing beside her; quiet or private places stay empty. Pokémon, animals or other creatures that belong to the place may appear, each separate from her at its own natural scale, never merged with her body. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may leave the frame past the forearm, never floating without its arm; fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
